summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Gradle Kotlin DSL buildInfo exclusions configuration specific to Spring Boot 3.0 migration. It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills (which cover Flink watermark/buffer configuration and unrelated domains). Peer candidates (Maven plugin config, Spring Security dispatcher types, properties migrator) are complementary Spring Boot 3.0 migration skills at the same granularity but address different build tools and configuration aspects. No existing skill covers Gradle Kotlin DSL buildInfo exclusions. Supported by Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide with no conflicts.
